pullRequests.head: pr/handwritten-asm-2
pullRequests.body:
This follows #109. Two more level functions are assembly in the original. They are classified the way docs/ASM_CLASSIFICATION.md does it for level code: listed by hand in config/overlays/handwritten_asm.txt, their INCLUDE_ASM stubs become ASM_FUNC, and the report counts them as finished original-source work. ASM_FUNC is INCLUDE_ASM, so the same asm/overlays/*.s is included and the image does not change.
This needs no new rule. Each function is the level programs' copy of an executable function…
